summary: Implemented executor window-function support with planner window stages, QUALIFY handling, named windows, ranking, aggregate/frame/navigation semantics, exclusions, grouped windows, composition, and subquery compatibility. Added efficient partition sorting, prefix/segment-tree frame aggregation, and tested representative and 50k-row cases.
